title: Ants Outnumber Humans, Yet Human Carbon Biomass Reaches 60 Megatons
hook: Human carbon biomass reaches 60 megatons, exceeding that of the vastly more numerous ants.
closing: Being numerous and being heavy are different advantages; tiny ants dominate headcounts without outweighing humanity.
question: Which matters more to you: numbers or mass?

segments.say: Ants hold 12 megatons of carbon biomass in this comparison. That exceeds the wild mammals and wild birds combined.
Human carbon biomass totals 60 megatons in the comparison. Larger individual bodies outweigh the ants' enormous headcount.
There are roughly 2.4 million ants per human in these data. Tiny individuals can dominate a headcount while losing on mass.
